Plot the Next Dose Combination of a BOIN Drug-Combination Trial

Source: R/plot.comb_boin_next.R
plot.comb_boin_next.Rd

Draw the dose matrix of a drug-combination trial with the data observed at every combination, the current combination, the combination chosen for the next cohort and the combinations eliminated, as returned by comb_boin_next.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'comb_boin_next'
plot(x, text_size = 1, colors = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class comb_boin_next.

text_size

Numeric scalar. Multiplier applied to every text size in the figure. Use a larger value when the figure is exported at high resolution. Defaults to 1.

colors

Named character vector of five colors, with names "Next", "Current", "Eliminated", "Treated" and "Not treated". Defaults to the palette of plot.boin_decision_table, with gray and white for the combinations that are neither current, next nor eliminated.

...

Further arguments, currently ignored.

Value

A ggplot2 object, which can be printed, saved with ggplot2::ggsave() or extended with further layers.

Details

Each cell shows the number of patients with a DLT and the number treated, and the status of the current, next and eliminated combinations is also written in the cell, so the figure does not rely on color alone. The candidates of an escalation or a de-escalation also show the posterior probability that their DLT rate lies between lambda_e and lambda_d. The levels of drug A run up the vertical axis and those of drug B along the horizontal axis.

Requires the ggplot2 package, which is only suggested by simFastBOIN rather than required.

See also

comb_boin_next

Examples

n_pts <- matrix(c(6, 6, 0, 0,
                  3, 3, 0, 0,
                  0, 0, 0, 0), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
n_tox <- matrix(c(0, 1, 0, 0,
                  1, 2, 0, 0,
                  0, 0, 0, 0), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

nxt <- comb_boin_next(target = 0.25, n_pts = n_pts, n_tox = n_tox,
                      current = c(2, 2))
plot(nxt)
